name: Order of the White Rose
source: Follow Shura and the Order of the White Rose as they battle against demons and other supernatural creatures. As he joins forces with the Order he will learn about an underworld that exists within the city, a battle of good and evil stretching for hundreds of years, and a secret about his past that may put him at the center of the current struggle.
translation: 跟随修罗和白玫瑰骑士团对抗恶魔和其他超自然生物。当他与凤凰社联手时，他将了解这座城市中存在的黑社会、一场绵延数百年的善恶之战，以及一个关于他过去的秘密，这可能会让他成为当前斗争的中心。
